name: kindle
notes: Kindle for Mac. Open the book yourself and run with --no-open. Pages turn with the right arrow key. Choose a single-column layout and a fixed font size in the reader settings before capturing; the app renders the next page slightly after the key press, which the settle check absorbs. If `see --ocr` refuses because the window exposes no accessibility elements, the Vision engine is used automatically when the Swift toolchain is installed.
